q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 16, 2026. NVIDIA will announce Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026. This gives us approximately **10 days** until the guidance is revealed.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provided contains the answer directly: **NVIDIA has already provided Q2 FY2027 forward guidance on May 20, 2026, of $91.0 billion ± 2%**.

This means the guidance range is:
- Lower bound: $91.0B × 0.98 = **$89.18 billion**
- Upper bound: $91.0B × 1.02 = **$92.82 billion**
- Midpoint: **$91.0 billion**

The earnings release on August 26, 2026 will confirm this guidance (or potentially reaffirm it with minor adjustments if circumstances have changed). Since the guidance was already provided ~3 months prior to the earnings release, NVIDIA will either:
1. Reaffirm the $91.0B ± 2% guidance
2. Update it if material changes occurred in the interim

Given that we're only 10 days from the earnings call and the guidance is already public, the most likely outcome is confirmation or very modest revision.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Significant deterioration in demand (unlikely given NVIDIA's market position)
- Unexpected supply chain disruptions
- Adverse macro/geopolitical developments affecting customer capex
- Steeper-than-expected impact from China restrictions mentioned in the guidance
- Customer inventory corrections or spending cuts

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected demand for AI infrastructure
- Higher ASPs (average selling prices) for advanced chips
- Better product mix toward higher-margin products
- Upside surprise from non-China markets offsetting any weakness
- Pull-forward of demand ahead of new product releases

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The specific guidance of **$91.0 billion ± 2%** is explicitly stated in the CURRENT RESEARCH section from NVIDIA's official investor relations announcement on May 20, 2026. This is not a historical base rate but the actual forward guidance already provided by the company.

## Reasoning

This is unusual as a forecasting question because the guidance has already been publicly announced. The question asks what the guidance "will be" in the earnings release, but it has already been released to the market via the May 20 earnings announcement.

The most probable outcome is that NVIDIA reaffirms or makes only minor adjustments to the $91.0B ± 2% guidance when reporting actual Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026.

The distribution should be concentrated around the stated guidance midpoint of $91.0 billion, with the ±2% range representing the company's own uncertainty estimate.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (Q2 FY2027) revenue. On May 20, 2026, when reporting Q1 FY2027 earnings, NVIDIA stated that it expects Q2 FY2027 revenue to be **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance is significantly above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 outlook explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The company will discuss its Q2 FY2027 financial results on August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).

Other forward guidance provided on May 20, 2026, for Q2 FY2027 includes:
*   GAAP gross margin: 74.9% plus or minus 50 basis points [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/)
*   Non-GAAP gross margin: 75.0% plus or minus 50 basis points [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/)
*   GAAP operating expenses: approximately $8.5 billion [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/)
*   Non-GAAP operating expenses: approximately $8.3 billion [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/)
